resolution.note: Fast plans a test that reaches a change through at most one module between, and a spawning test only for the core entry or a command's own modules and their direct imports; the rest is listed as left to CI. Over 60 merged commits the average local plan drops from 23.3 to 12.9 tests (spawning tests 490 to 157); a packet.ts change runs 24 tests, not 103. Local wall and lane-PR red Check rate are to be watched over the next two weeks.

title: Local fast runs only the tests a change touches and leaves the wide set to CI
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19; operator grant: host-wide queue for all projects, krn-dev for batch work under caps (memory host-capacity-grant). Evidence: laptop Ryzen 5700U 16 threads, load 17-25, CPU 56% user 28% sys 16% idle, swap ~9 GB zram, /mnt/storage 92% full; KRN lane npm run fast took 25+ min vs 2-3; live CPU split: krn ~120%, mise-en-plesk ~140%, desktop/Chrome ~160%, elektroinstal 38%, rss-news 35%, CI containers.
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts, scripts/lib/fast-plan.ts, test/scripts/fast-plan.test.ts
Evidence: a change to src/brain/packet.ts made fast plan 99 tests (import consumers widened); each lane PR then runs CI's full Check again.
Outcome: fast's plan caps import-consumer widening (direct importers and changed tests, or a measured cap) and prints what it left to CI; median local fast wall on lane changes halves without more red Checks on lane PRs over 2 weeks.
Proof: `node --test test/scripts/fast-plan.test.ts: pass` (a packet.ts change plans at most its direct importers' tests).
